blockers.desc: spec §3.1 anchor-A specifies 'meta-llama/Llama-3.2-3B' (base completion model); ubu1 cache has 'Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct' only. Public lm-eval HellaSwag/MMLU/TriviaQA reference numbers in spec §2.2 are typically reported against the BASE model, not Instruct. Using Instruct will pass §3.2 criterion 1 (anchors run) but may fail criterion 2 (within ±10% of public model card) because Instruct has been chat-tuned and shifts knowledge benchmarks (typically MMLU +1-3pt, HellaSwag −1-2pt, TriviaQA mixed).
resolution_options: OPT-A: download meta-llama/Llama-3.2-3B base (~6GB, ~5min on ubu1 with HF token) — strict spec compliance
OPT-B: proceed with Instruct + spec amendment (§2.6 procedure; new dated spec doc) — cheaper but pre-registration violation per §7.1 caveat (a)
OPT-C: run BOTH and report both anchor numbers (recommended — full spec compliance + Instruct as bonus reference)
blockers.recommendation: OPT-A first (strict §2.6 compliance); OPT-C if user authorizes ~6GB extra download
